adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new loop over `event.destinationCalendar` tries to resolve a `credential` first from `this.calendarCredentials`, then via `prisma.credential.findUnique(...)`. If neither yields a usable credential (e.g., not found, or found but `app.slug` missing so `credential` is never constructed), the code falls through past `if (credential) { ... createdEvents.push(...) }` without pushing any failure `EventResult` and without logging. The loop then continues, so that destination is silently skipped and the overall flow can still succeed with fewer created events than intended.
